item.title: US men’s hockey beats Germany to stay unbeaten at Olympics; Canada earns top seed
item.description: MILAN — Matthew Tkachuk insists he and his U.S. teammates were only focused on beating Germany in their preliminary round finale and never worried about scoring enough goals to pass Canada for the top seed at the Olympics.

item.title: Rice Twp. to hold public meeting on data center ordinance
item.description: Rice Township next month will likely join a growing list of municipalities in Luzerne County that have introduced regulations on data centers.

item.title: LEGISLATIVE ROUNDUP: Fetterman secures nearly $300M in federal funds for PA projects
item.description: U.S. Sen. John Fetterman, D-Braddock, this week announced that $289,366,974 in Congressionally Directed Spending (CDS) funding was included in the 11 FY26 Appropriations bills signed into law — supporting 121 projects focused on affordable housing development, water infrastructure upgrades, police department equipment, and other critical initiatives across Pennsylvania.

item.title: Eddie Bauer in WB Twp. to close following bankruptcy filing
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — Eddie Bauer at the Arena Hub Plaza is one of hundreds in the U.S. that will close its doors following an announcement last week that the retail operator had filed for bankruptcy.
